articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft drops 167 security fixes including a SharePoint zero-day and the deliciously named 'BlueHammer' Windows Defender flaw. Because apparently even Microsoft's own security tools need security patches now.

articles.title: Britain's £6B armoured sickener Ajax cleared for duty despite injuring troops
articles.summary: Critical cPanel vulnerability grants root access to millions of domains, likely exploited as a zero-day before patches arrived. When your web hosting control panel becomes the ultimate skeleton key.

articles.title: Google Fixes CVSS 10 Gemini CLI CI RCE and Cursor Flaws Enable Code Execution
articles.summary: Linux 'Copy Fail' vulnerability lets unprivileged users become root across major distros with a CVSS 7.8 score. Even the penguin isn't safe from privilege escalation shenanigans.

articles.title: SAP-Related npm Packages Compromised in Credential-Stealing Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: Google patches perfect 10.0 CVSS flaw in Gemini CLI that enabled remote code execution. When your AI assistant becomes everyone's backdoor, that's a problem worth fixing immediately.

articles.title: Leila Chatti on the Many Ways to Be (and Not to Be) a Mother
articles.summary: CISA orders federal agencies to patch Windows vulnerability actively exploited as zero-day. Uncle Sam finally admitting that maybe, just maybe, patching is important.

articles.title: ‘CanisterWorm’ Springs Wiper Attack Targeting Iran
articles.summary: Germany unmasks 'UNKN,' the elusive Russian mastermind behind REvil and GandCrab ransomware operations. 31-year-old Daniil Shchukin gets his closeup after 130 acts of digital mayhem.

articles.title: The GUARD Act Isn’t Targeting Dangerous AI—It’s Blocking Everyday Internet Use
articles.summary: EFF argues the Open Social Web needs Section 230 protection to challenge Big Tech dominance. Ironically, the law everyone loves to hate might be the key to digital freedom.

articles.title: Claude Mythos Fears Startle Japan's Financial Services Sector
articles.summary: EFF demands Congress reject insufficient Section 702 reauthorization bill as surveillance state expansion continues. Speaker Johnson's 'Foreign Intelligence Accountability Act' sounds like accountability theater.

articles.title: CISA orders feds to patch Windows flaw exploited as zero-day
articles.summary: Supply chain attack compromises SAP-related npm packages with credential-stealing malware. When enterprise software dependencies become the weakest link in the security chain.

articles.title: GitHub fixes RCE flaw that gave access to millions of private repos
articles.summary: French police arrest 21-year-old 'HexDex' for allegedly conducting 100 data breaches including France's Ministry of Education. Kid went from homework to homework on government servers.
